overview: Lots of people moving into or out of Raleigh are crossing state lines, not just town lines. Better Life Moving is an interstate carrier with our own crews here, so a move from Boston, Chicago or the West Coast can have our people at both ends.
Moving across town works too, billed by the hour.
sellingPoints: Interstate moves into and out of the Triangle
Apex and Wake Forest moves as well

servicesBlock.h2: Moving Services Our Raleigh Crews Handle
servicesBlock.intro: Our Raleigh crews handle new-construction move-ins, apartment moves and relocations from out of state. Every service listed is available here, and long distance moves out of Raleigh have their own page.

whyChoose.h2: Why Relocating Families Choose Us in Raleigh

cards.title: Crews on Both Ends
cards.text: With crews in Boston, Charlotte, Chicago and Los Angeles as well as here, many interstate moves never change hands.

cards.title: Gate Codes and HOA Rules
cards.text: Moving into a gated or HOA community? Send the gate code and any truck rules when you book, and the crew plans around them.

cards.title: Loading Docks Booked in Advance
cards.text: Buildings with a loading dock usually set reservation windows. Give us yours and the truck arrives inside it.

cards.title: Checkable Federal Authority
cards.text: Our USDOT 3866930 and MC 1414489 are on the FMCSA public record. Look them up before you sign anything.

faqHeading: Answers for People Moving to or From Raleigh

faq.q: Do Raleigh movers from Better Life Moving cover Apex and Wake Forest?
faq.a: Yes. Apex and Wake Forest moves are handled by our Raleigh crews, billed the same way as a move inside the city.

faq.q: Can you move my family from another state into Raleigh?
faq.a: Yes. Moves into the Triangle from out of state are long distance moves, quoted at a flat rate and carried on our own trucks.

faq.q: How are local moves in Raleigh billed?
faq.a: Local moves are billed hourly, with travel time from our yard added, and a 2-hour minimum that includes travel time. Blankets, wrap and truck costs sit inside that rate.

faq.q: We're moving into a new-construction home in Raleigh. What should we tell you?
faq.a: The closing date, the community's gate or HOA rules and whether the driveway is finished. Those decide where the truck can park and when the crew can start.

faq.q: Can you pack and store our things during a Raleigh relocation?
faq.a: Yes. Packing and storage go on the same quote as the move, and storage is priced by the cubic feet your items take up.

faqClosing: Need more answers before your Raleigh move? Our FAQ page covers billing and booking in detail.

closing.h2: Book Movers for Your Raleigh Move
closing.body: Coming in from another state or moving across town, send the date and both addresses and we'll price the move.
